title: F22 · slow_month · No Customers
lines: n
Forty rupees. That was today.
n
Across the road, the new store has a queue out of the door.
n
His father ran this shop for forty years.
He is afraid he will be the one to close it.
n
He started pulling the shutter down early.
n
An old man ducked under it. One washer. The small kind.
An old man ducked under it. "One washer. The small kind."
s
The river did not reach the ashes in a day. A king stood on one leg for years.
n
Papa pushed the shutter back up,
and wrote on a board: Free home delivery. Repairs done.
and wrote on a board: "Free home delivery. Repairs done."
n
Slow is not finished. Stand a little longer. That is sadhana.
